wave_title: A Parsed, language-tagged artifact with no registered SemanticExtractor at all no longer silently vanishes from CensusExtractionAccounting. `.atlas/contracts/SEMANTIC-EXTRACTION.md#failure-semantics`.

generation_model.G_n: ebc53574ca (docs(evidence): correct dependency-census generation verification record) -- stable generation this candidate was built and validated against
generation_model.gap_discovered_by: auditing the codebase for the same 'vacuous closure/silent disappearance' bug class just fixed for DependencyClosureReport, applied to every other is_closed()-style accounting method in the repository. runtime::census::extraction::CensusExtractionAccounting::is_closed() uses grouped.values().all(...), which is vacuously true for zero groups -- structurally the same risk shape. Tracing why zero groups could occur led to extract_semantics's `if extractors.is_empty() { continue; }` branch, which produces no batch, no obligation and no diagnostic for such an artifact. Confirmed LIVE (not hypothetical) by querying this repository's own real inventory via `cargo run -p atlas-cli -- systemize`: 64 Parsed artifacts, only 58 'rust' (with a registered extractor); 3 toml + 1 markdown + 2 json artifacts hit this exact silent-skip path today. Further confirmed by finding `DiagnosticCode::UnsupportedLanguageOrProfile` declared in the vocabulary (core/src/semantic/diagnostic.rs) but never constructed anywhere in the codebase -- a named, evidently-intended-but-never-wired case.

priority_classification: correctness/architectural integrity (priority 1) AND census blindness (priority 4) -- this is a live violation of ExtractionDiagnostic's own documented invariant ('a diagnostic never removes the artifact or the dimension from accounting') in this repository's own real self-census today, not merely a hypothetical for other admitted repos.

design_decisions.question: Should the fallback use SemanticExtractor::unavailable (the existing read-failure path)?
design_decisions.decision: No -- `unavailable` is a trait method requiring a concrete extractor instance (`&self`), and none exists when zero extractors are registered for the language at all. A free function (`unsupported_language_batch`) building the ExtractionBatch directly was required.

design_decisions.question: UNKNOWN or UNSUPPORTED for every dimension?
design_decisions.decision: UNSUPPORTED -- this is 'no extractor capable of analyzing this language exists', not 'evidence was unobtainable for a capable extractor' (which is what UNKNOWN already means via `unavailable`). Matches the existing ObligationResult::unsupported vs ::unknown distinction a single extractor's own unsupported dimensions already draw.

design_decisions.question: What ExtractorIdentity to attribute the batch to, with no real extractor involved?
design_decisions.decision: A sentinel `NO_EXTRACTOR` constant with empty id/version strings, documented explicitly as never a real extractor's identity, so it can never be confused with genuine extractor lineage in CensusExtractionAccounting/SemanticObligationRecord.

design_decisions.question: Which DiagnosticCode?
design_decisions.decision: DiagnosticCode::UnsupportedLanguageOrProfile -- already declared in the vocabulary for exactly this case, previously dead code. Reused rather than inventing a new code, per the loop's own 'use existing repository vocabulary' rule.

stable_validator_law_compliance.claim: A Parsed artifact whose language has no registered extractor now produces a closed ExtractionBatch (every requested dimension UNSUPPORTED, one diagnostic) instead of silently vanishing, and this does not regress the aggregate per-dimension census.coverage.
stable_validator_law_compliance.self_written_evidence: Rewrote the existing test (previously named `extract_semantics_skips_artifacts_with_no_registered_extractor`, which asserted the OLD silent-skip behavior as intentional) to `extract_semantics_accounts_for_artifacts_with_no_registered_extractor_explicitly`, asserting the batch exists, is closed over all 12 dimensions, every obligation is UNSUPPORTED with a diagnostic, and the diagnostic code is UnsupportedLanguageOrProfile.
stable_validator_law_compliance.independent_evidence_channel: Ran the pre-existing systemize CLI against this repository's own real root before and after the fix and diffed census.typed_closure.typed_obligations_total: 696 before, 768 after -- an increase of exactly 72 = 6 (the real toml/markdown/json artifacts) x 12 (ALL_SEMANTIC_DIMENSIONS), precisely matching the predicted effect with no off-by-one or double-count. census.coverage (the aggregate per-dimension summary) is byte-identical before and after, confirming status_rank's max-based aggregation correctly prevents the new UNSUPPORTED entries from downgrading dimensions already OBSERVED/UNKNOWN from real Rust extraction. coding_admission.allowed stays true throughout. This is real self-consistency evidence from the same binary, not claimed as circularly-independent per the correction recorded in dependency-census-independent-validator-correction.json -- it is offered here as a quantitative regression/effect check, not as sole proof of correctness (that is the rewritten unit test's job).

implementation.core_kernel: no core type changes -- reuses existing ExtractionBatch/ObligationResult/ExtractionDiagnostic/DiagnosticCode
implementation.extraction: runtime/src/census/extraction.rs -- unsupported_language_batch(), NO_EXTRACTOR sentinel, wired into extract_semantics's `extractors.is_empty()` branch

adversarial_and_falsification_coverage: extract_semantics_accounts_for_artifacts_with_no_registered_extractor_explicitly -- the exact regression this generation fixes, on a real markdown fixture file
full workspace test suite (404 tests) re-run clean, including every existing R4.3.1-R4.3.3 production-wiring test (read-failure isolation, real Rust extraction) unaffected by this change

a future generation adding a second language extractor (e.g. a second real SemanticExtractor) will naturally reduce how many artifacts hit this fallback path; that is expected evolution, not a regression of this fix

overall_verdict: MATERIALIZED AND VERIFIED. Fixes a real, live violation of SEMANTIC-EXTRACTION.md's own 'a diagnostic never removes the artifact from accounting' rule, discovered by systematically auditing for the same bug class fixed last generation in a different subsystem (dependency closure). Quantitatively confirmed via typed_obligations_total delta matching the exact predicted effect, with zero regression to aggregate coverage or coding admission.
